subject: Recap + next steps: inference unit-econ pressure (pilot proposal)
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@fineva.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's call

Sofia — thanks for a helpful conversation today. A quick recap from our side so we're aligned: 

- Main pain: per-token spend has jumped ~2.8x over the last 6 months as we scale chat assistants (peak cost >$0.0009/token).
- Current stack: hosted LLM endpoints (multi-region), custom shard-based caching at app layer (inefficient), no KV-cache reuse across turns.
- Ops pain: tail latency on business hours spikes and throttles some premium flows.
- Risk tolerance: engineering is wary of heavy quantization due to small but measurable degradation in slot-filling accuracy on our payment flows.

Success criteria we care about:
1) Unit cost reduction target: ~30–40% without >1% absolute drop in slot accuracy.
2) Latency SLO: 95th <= 600ms for short prompts.
3) Minimal engineering lift to integrate pilot (prefers proxy-style integration).

Attaching a small telemetry extract that shows token distribution and peak windows — "fineva-prod-telemetry.csv".

Maya
Product, Fineva

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@fineva.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call — pilot proposal and asks

Maya — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the telemetry. I pulled a few quick takeaways and propose a concise pilot to validate cost + quality levers. Short version below; full attachment: "redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf".

What we heard (confirm if I missed anything):
- Cost pressure driven by high token volumes + low reuse (short slash-thin prefixes).
- Current caching is app-level and not leveraging model KV reuse — opportunity for substantial per-token savings.
- Engineering is cautious about quantization impact; open to controlled A/B testing with regen checks.

Proposed 6-week pilot (objectives + success criteria):
- Objectives: 1) Reduce effective token cost by >=30% on pilot traffic; 2) Keep slot/intent accuracy within 1% absolute of baseline; 3) Demonstrate end-to-end integration pattern with minimal infra change.
- Key levers we will test: a) model variant selection + lower-cost routing for non-sensitive flows; b) continuous batching and adaptive batch-window config; c) prefix/KV caching at the inference layer (transparent to app); d) lightweight quantization A/B with human-in-the-loop QA on a sampled slice.
- Metrics to monitor: per-token cost, tokens/response, 95th latency, regen rate, slot accuracy (daily).

Asks from Fineva to start scope + sizing: 
1) Sample prompt set and 7-day production traffic profile (token histogram + per-route qps). You sent a telemetry sample — thank you; a week-long extract helps tuning.
2) A prioritized list of flows to include in the pilot (e.g., payments auth, helpdesk, onboarding).
3) Contact for procurement (for pilot agreement) and estimated approval timeline.

Next steps / proposed timeline:
- This week: share pilot proposal (attached) and a short SOW sketch.
- Week 1: onboarding access + baseline measurement.
- Weeks 2–5: iterative tuning (batching, caching, quantization A/B).
- Week 6: readout and rollout recommendations.

If this matches your expectations I'm happy to schedule a 30-min sync with Aditya (SE) and Monica (CS) to walk the pilot plan and any security questions.

Best —
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
